messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Added **Deal name** under “Reproduce a game.” Exporting and loading a snapshot now preserves its name.

Fixed pasted saves being rejected because their JSON fields appeared in a different order. Existing unnamed saves and replays remain compatible.

All 149 unit/static tests, 83 browser checks, type checks, and builds passed. Changed files pass formatting; 13 pre-existing formatting failures remain documented in [README.md](/work/README.md).

All code changes were made by subagents.
